blocks.text: Original document: [docs/HIGHLIGHT_ANIMATION_ARCHITECTURE.md](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/docs/HIGHLIGHT_ANIMATION_ARCHITECTURE.md). See [current limitations](/limitations) for concrete compatibility notes.

In motion graphics, technical presentations, educational tutorials, and algorithmic visualizers, drawing the viewer's attention to specific visual entities is a critical pattern. Common use cases include:

items: Circling a key mathematical equation or code token.
Underlining an important takeaway or headline.
Sweeping a translucent highlighter pen behind a line of text.
Bursting sparkles, light gleams, or flash rings when an entity finishes generating.
Pulsing or wiggling an element to communicate an alert, hover, or invalid state.

blocks.text: Prior to this architecture, highlight effects in Retiam suffered from several architectural issues:

items: **Core Engine Bloat**: Miscellaneous visual effects such as `Flash` and `Blink` were coupled directly into `src/engine/animation/indication/`, polluting the core graphics pipeline with non-engine UI idioms.
**Scattered Ad-Hoc Geometries**: Callout boxes and underline strokes had to be manually constructed by calculating bounding boxes in scene scripts, placing boilerplate clutter in animations.

**Manual Scene Graph Management**: Developers had to explicitly invoke `scene.add(box)` and remember to `scene.remove(box)` afterwards. Failure to do so led to memory leaks and ghost meshes in the WebGPU frame graph.
**Target Entity Mutation**: Animating temporary emphasis often altered the target entity's own properties (`scale`, `rotation`, `color`) without restoring initial values on completion.

blocks.text: Retiam introduces a dedicated, modular **Highlight Animation Subsystem** located in [`libs/highlights/`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/highlights/index.ts) and exported under the package alias `"retiam/highlights"`.

items: Completely removes indication logic from `src/engine/` to maintain a lean, core rendering engine.
Introduces **15 high-fidelity animations** spanning 5 distinct visual categories.
Automates bounding box resolution, coordinate alignment, and automatic scene injection.
Provides automatic, leak-free cleanup (`attachAutoCleanup`) while supporting permanent callouts via `{ persist: true }`.
Preserves and restores target entity state for all transform- and material-based animations.

blocks.text: For boundary, backdrop, and particle effects, the highlight system dynamically constructs auxiliary vector entities (`Poly`, `Line`, `Group`, `Rectangle`). The target entity's children hierarchy is left untouched, preventing unintended layout or tree distortions.
Retiam's scene runner requires newly spawned entities to be registered with the active `Scene`. All transient highlight animations configure:

blocks.code: this.isIntroducer = true;

blocks.text: When passed to `scene.play(new Circumscribe(myText))`, the engine automatically registers the underlying visual overlay without requiring the caller to invoke `scene.add(highlightEntity)`.
All transient highlight animations bind to their completion promise through [`attachAutoCleanup`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/highlights/core/utils.ts#L45-L70):

blocks.code: attachAutoCleanup(anim: Animation, entities: Entity | Entity[], persist: boolean = false);

items: **When `persist === false` (default)**: As soon as `anim.promise` resolves, all generated auxiliary entities are detached from the active `Scene` and destroyed via `entity.destroy()`, purging vertex and uniform buffers from GPU memory.
**When `persist === true`**: The highlight stays rendered at its final state indefinitely (useful for permanent callouts, sticky borders, or annotations).

blocks.text: Inherent highlights that alter the target entity directly (e.g., [`ColorTint`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/highlights/material/ColorTint.ts), [`PopHighlight`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/highlights/motion/PopHighlight.ts), [`WiggleHighlight`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/highlights/motion/WiggleHighlight.ts)) snapshot original material and transform properties before execution:
This guarantees zero property drift or unintended permanent transformations.
The highlight library is structured into 5 cohesive categories in [`libs/highlights/`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/highlights/index.ts):

cells.text: Vector contours and technical framings encircling the target's bounding box.
Plate and marker backgrounds sweeping or fading beneath target content.
Celebration bursts, specular glints, and radial flashes indicating completion.
Inherent surface modulations including color transitions, aura pulsing, and blinking.
Dynamic kinetic impulses (elastic pops and harmonic wiggles).

blocks.text: Draws a vector stroke path contour completely framing the target entity, then fades it out smoothly.

children: `shape?: "rect" | "circle" | "pill"`: Geometry shape enclosing the target. Default: `"rect"`.
`cornerRadius?: number`: Corner rounding for rect and pill shapes. Default: `0.1`.
`stroke_width?: number`: Outline stroke thickness. Default: `0.06`.
`duration?: number`: Total animation time in ms. Default: `1000`.

blocks.text: Spawns 4 technical HUD corner brackets that frame the target's bounding box, sliding slightly inward while fading out.

children: `bracketLength?: number`: Arm length of each L-shaped bracket. Default: `0.4`.
`stroke_width?: number`: Line thickness. Default: `0.06`.
`duration?: number`: Total time in ms. Default: `900`.

blocks.text: Draws a stylized underline stroke beneath the bottom edge of the target bounding box.

children: `style?: "straight" | "wavy"`: Style of the underline stroke. Default: `"straight"`.
`offset?: number`: Distance below the target bottom bounds. Default: `0.1`.
`waves?: number`: Number of oscillation cycles when `style: "wavy"`. Default: `4`.
`stroke_width?: number`: Thickness of the stroke line. Default: `0.06`.

blocks.text: Emits an expanding shockwave pulse from the target's perimeter that scales outward and dissolves into the background.

children: `expandScale?: number`: Maximum expansion multiplier relative to target size. Default: `1.4`.
`stroke_width?: number`: Outline stroke thickness. Default: `0.05`.
`duration?: number`: Total ripple time in ms. Default: `800`.

blocks.text: Simulates a translucent fluorescent highlighter stroke drawn horizontally across the target.

children: `opacity?: number`: Target fill opacity of the highlighter plate. Default: `0.35`.
`cornerRadius?: number`: Rounding on marker edges. Default: `0.08`.
`direction?: "left-to-right" | "right-to-left"`. Default: `"left-to-right"`.

blocks.text: Fades in a rounded plate directly behind the target entity and fades it out smoothly.

children: `opacity?: number`: Peak opacity of the card plate. Default: `0.25`.
`cornerRadius?: number`: Corner rounding. Default: `0.15`.
`duration?: number`: Time in ms. Default: `1000`.

blocks.text: Sweeps a diagonal specular light beam across the target's bounding box, creating a premium gleam upon entity creation.

children: `bandWidth?: number`: Width of the specular sweep line. Default: `0.3`.
`duration?: number`: Duration in ms. Default: `750`.

blocks.text: Erupts 4-point star glints from the corners and perimeter of the entity that expand and vanish.

children: `count?: number`: Number of sparkles spawned. Default: `4`.
`sparkleSize?: number`: Maximum arm radius of each sparkle. Default: `0.3`.
`duration?: number`: Time in ms. Default: `700`.

blocks.text: Produces a camera-flash bloom disk and shockwave ring centered directly on the target.

children: `intensity?: number`: Flash scale multiplier. Default: `1.0`.
`duration?: number`: Time in ms. Default: `600`.

blocks.text: Animates a radial burst of outgoing vector line rays from the center of the entity.

children: `num_lines?: number`: Number of radial rays. Default: `12`.
`line_length?: number`: Length of each ray. Default: `0.2`.
`flash_radius?: number`: Starting offset radius from center. Default: `0.5`.
`stroke_width?: number`: Thickness of the rays. Default: `0.04`.

blocks.text: Smoothly shifts the target entity's material color to the highlight accent, holds the color, and returns smoothly to original colors.

children: `holdDuration?: number`: Milliseconds to sustain peak tint color. Default: `300`.
`duration?: number`: Total transition time in ms. Default: `900`.

blocks.text: Modulates a soft radiant glow plate behind the target using sinusoidal harmonic breathing pulses.

children: `pulses?: number`: Total number of breathing cycles. Default: `2`.
`opacity?: number`: Peak glow opacity. Default: `0.4`.
`duration?: number`: Total duration in ms. Default: `1200`.

blocks.text: Strobe-flashes the target entity's visibility on and off at a specified frequency.

children: `num_blinks?: number`: Number of blink cycles. Default: `3`.
`duration?: number`: Total time in ms. Default: `1000`.

blocks.text: Applies an elastic scale impulse and rebound to the entity around its current anchor, instantly catching viewer focus without changing permanent layout dimensions.

children: `scaleFactor?: number`: Maximum peak scale multiplier. Default: `1.2`.
`duration?: number`: Time in ms. Default: `500`.

blocks.text: Applies a decaying sinusoidal angular oscillation (shake/wiggle) to indicate attention or invalid action.

children: `angle?: number`: Peak rotation amplitude in radians. Default: `0.12` (~7°).
`wiggles?: number`: Number of complete oscillation cycles. Default: `3`.
`duration?: number`: Total wiggle time in ms. Default: `600`.

blocks.text: Highlight animations are standard Retiam animations. They compose seamlessly using `scene.play()`, [`Sequential`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/Sequential.ts), or [`Concurrent`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/src/engine/animation/Concurrent.ts):

The bounding utility [`resolveTargetAABB`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/libs/highlights/core/utils.ts#L10-L22) accepts either a single `Entity` or an `Entity[]`. You can circumscribe or underline multiple entities as a unified cluster:
Set `persist: true` when a highlight boundary or marker mark should remain on screen after the animation completes:
Retiam's bundler scans the `libs/` directory for any subfolder with an `index.ts`.

Each highlight animation has a dedicated, standalone demo scene in [`examples/demos/highlights/`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/examples/demos/highlights) and is registered in [`examples/demos.ts`](https://github.com/abhilasbiswas/Retiam/blob/main/examples/demos.ts):
Automated unit tests are located in `test/highlights_test.ts` and verify:

items: Instantiation and default options for all 15 animations.
Bounding box resolution (`resolveTargetAABB`) for single and grouped entities.
Non-persistence cleanup (`attachAutoCleanup`) and persistence retention flags.
Type safety and WebGPU pipeline decoupling.
